evaluationBoundary.isolation: Copy candidate to temporary directory; temporary data directories and fresh nonpersistent Chromium context; no existing Profile or Chrome executable override. Both input.env and normal process.env CPM_DATA_DIR/APPDATA/XDG_CONFIG_HOME point to the same temporary fixture, including custom-root cases. Either environment lookup style is valid. This is not an OS sandbox for malicious candidate code.

positiveControls.process-environment: Equivalent fix resolving registry locations from normal process.env rather than the optional injected input.env; all checks must pass.
